headline: Your refrigerator has entered its use-me-or-lose-me era
body:
Tonight, your refrigerator is in its “use me or lose me” era, while your AI assistant is pretending it has X-ray vision.

Do not ask, “What should I make for dinner?” Give it the actual cast: the ingredients you have, what expires first, how much time you have, the equipment available and any dietary restrictions. Ask for three options and tell it to flag every ingredient it assumed rather than found in your list.

That changes the answer because AI cannot see your refrigerator. Specific context narrows the recipes it can plausibly assemble; it does not make the tool a food-safety expert.

Check allergies, safe temperatures and whether the alleged lemon exists before cooking. Tonight’s stars favour dinner over a fourth grocery order. Mercury accepts no responsibility for imaginary coriander.
